# Charts still republished under the same version (3.5.0, 0.1.0, ...) by their
# repositories. update-index.yml lets these be overwritten or deleted on master; every
# other chart is append-only there, so a published version never changes. Remove a chart
# from this list once its repository publishes through publish-chart (dev channel on its
# main branch, a new version for each release); for the v3.5.0 components that is right
# after their v3.5.0 release republishes 3.5.0 one last time.
#
# "*" unguards every chart: published versions may be overwritten until the 3.5 platform
# release is cut (decided 2026-10-26, while the core components are at v3.5.0-rc.N).
# Remove it at the release-3.5 cut.
*
authentik
kubevirt-xpu-device-plugin
petasus-resource-manager
pulley-spider
